offices.name: United States Patent and Trademark Office

definitions.text: Defined in 37 CFR 1.27(a) as a person, a small business concern or a nonprofit organization. Small business concerns follow SBA size standards (13 CFR 121.801 to 121.805).

Qualifies as a small entity, has been named as inventor on no more than four previously filed applications, and had prior-year gross income within the maximum qualifying gross income (three times the US median household income).

definitions.category: Micro entity (institution of higher education basis)
definitions.text: Qualifies as a small entity and either is mainly employed by a US institution of higher education or has assigned, or is obliged to assign, ownership to one.

fee_reductions.as_published: the small entity discount was increased from 50 percent to 60 percent for most fees
fee_reductions.fees: Most patent fees (filing, search, examination, issue, maintenance and others; some fees such as document supply fees are not reduced)

fee_reductions.as_published: an 80% reduction on most fees charged by the United States Patent and Trademark Office
fee_reductions.fees: Most patent fees

fee_reductions.as_published: Small entity amounts listed in the USPTO fee schedule (e.g. transmittal fee $285.00, small entity $114.00)
fee_reductions.fees: PCT: international-stage transmittal, search, supplemental search and preliminary examination fees; national stage basic, search and examination fees

fee_reductions.as_published: Micro entity amounts listed in the USPTO fee schedule (e.g. transmittal fee $285.00, micro entity $57.00)
fee_reductions.fees: PCT: international-stage transmittal, search, supplemental search and preliminary examination fees; national stage basic, search and examination fees

support.name: Patent Pro Bono Program
support.text: Connects inventors and small businesses with limited financial resources to volunteer patent attorneys and agents who help them file at no cost for legal services.

support.name: Pro Se Assistance Program
support.text: Gives procedural help, not legal advice, to independent inventors who file without a registered attorney or agent.

support.name: Inventors Assistance Center
support.text: Answers general questions on patent rules, forms, application formats and fees, and routes callers to the right USPTO staff.

definitions.text: Microenterprises (fewer than 10 staff and annual turnover or balance sheet total of no more than EUR 2 million), natural persons, non-profit organisations, universities and public research organisations, of any nationality or domicile, that filed fewer than five applications in the five years before the relevant date.
European Commission definition (Recommendation 2003/361/EC): an independent company with fewer than 250 staff and turnover below EUR 50 million and/or balance sheet below EUR 43 million.

fee_reductions.as_published: a 30% reduction in all main fees in the patent grant procedure
fee_reductions.fees: Filing, search, examination, designation and grant fees, and renewal fees
PCT: Euro-PCT applications in the European phase, including the supplementary European search fee and the examination fee

fee_reductions.category: SMEs, natural persons, non-profits, universities and public research organisations filing in a non-EPO language
fee_reductions.fees: Filing fee and examination fee, when filed in an official language of the applicant's EPC state other than English, French or German

support.name: Unitary Patent compensation scheme
support.text: A EUR 500 lump sum for translation costs to SMEs, natural persons, non-profits, universities and public research organisations based in an EU member state whose application was filed in an EU language other than English, French or German.

definitions.text: A company within the employee or capital limit for its industry (e.g. manufacturing up to 300 employees or JPY 300 million capital; retail up to 50 employees or JPY 50 million), not under the management of large enterprises. Foreign SMEs qualify on the same conditions.
A corporation with 20 employees or fewer (5 or fewer in commerce or services), not under the management of large enterprises.
A corporation established no more than 10 years ago with capital of no more than JPY 300 million, not under the management of large enterprises.
Individuals on public assistance or exempt from municipal tax, income tax or enterprise tax.

fee_reductions.fees: Request for examination fee; patent fees for years 1 to 10

fee_reductions.category: Micro enterprise / small and medium startup
fee_reductions.fees: Request for examination fee; patent fees for years 1 to 10

fee_reductions.as_published: Transmittal fee / Search fee: reduced to 1/2; Preliminary examination fee: reduced to 1/2; International filing fee and Handling fee: 1/2 supported
fee_reductions.fees: PCT: international applications filed in Japanese

fee_reductions.category: Micro enterprise / small and medium startup
fee_reductions.as_published: Transmittal fee / Search fee: reduced to 1/3; Preliminary examination fee: reduced to 1/3; International filing fee and Handling fee: 2/3 supported
fee_reductions.fees: PCT: international applications filed in Japanese
Request for examination fee; patent fees for years 1 to 10

fee_reductions.category: Individuals on public assistance or exempt from municipal tax
fee_reductions.as_published: Examination fees/Patent fees for year 1 to 3: Exempt; Patent fees for year 4 to 10: Reduced to 1/2
fee_reductions.fees: Request for examination fee and patent fees for years 1 to 3 (years 4 to 10 reduced by half)

support.name: Accelerated examination for SMEs
support.text: Applications by SMEs, individuals, universities and public research institutes can be examined ahead of the queue at no extra fee.

support.name: Super-accelerated examination for startups
support.text: Working-related applications filed by startups can get a faster track than accelerated examination, at no extra fee.

offices.name: Ministry of Intellectual Property of the Republic of Korea (formerly the Korean Intellectual Property Office)

definitions.text: Natural persons (개인); a higher reduction applies to people aged 19 to 29 or 65 and over.
SMEs (중소기업) and mid-sized enterprises (중견기업) are listed as separate categories; MOIP SME programmes refer to SMEs under Article 2 of the Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises.
An SME within 3 years of starting business (스타트업 기업, 사업개시일 3년 이내 중소기업).

fee_reductions.fees: Application fee, examination request fee, registration fees for the first 3 years (annual fees from year 4: 50% off)

fee_reductions.category: Individuals aged 19 to 29 or 65 and over
fee_reductions.fees: Application fee, examination request fee, registration fees for the first 3 years (annual fees from year 4: 50% off)
Application fee, examination request fee, registration fees for the first 3 years (annual fees from year 4: 50% off)
Application fee, examination request fee, registration fees for the first 3 years; annual fees for years 4 to 9
Priority examination request fee, up to 10 applications a year

support.name: Public-interest Patent Attorney Center (공익변리사 특허상담센터)
support.text: Free attorney services for small businesses and other vulnerable groups, from consultation and drafting to trials and support with infringement litigation costs.

support.name: IP Narae programme (IP 나래 프로그램)
support.text: Up to 100 days of IP strategy and management consulting for technology SMEs up to 7 years old (10 in new industries), 70% government funded.

support.name: Global IP Star Companies (글로벌 IP스타기업 육성)
support.text: Three years of IP support for exporting SMEs, including part of the cost of PCT and foreign filings.

support.name: IP Didimdol programme (IP 디딤돌 프로그램)
support.text: IP consulting for would-be founders, including most of the cost of filing a patent for the business idea.

definitions.text: Individuals whose average monthly income in the previous year was below RMB 5,000 (RMB 60,000 a year).
Enterprises whose taxable income in the previous year was below RMB 1 million.
Public institutions, social organisations and non-profit research institutions (no income threshold).

fee_reductions.fees: Application fee (excluding publication printing fee and surcharge), invention substantive examination fee, annual fees for 10 years from the year of grant, reexamination fee

fee_reductions.category: Two or more joint applicants or co-owners, each eligible
fee_reductions.fees: Application fee (excluding publication printing fee and surcharge), invention substantive examination fee, annual fees for 10 years from the year of grant, reexamination fee

support.name: SME IP Public Service Special Action 2026
support.text: Joint CNIPA and MIIT action in which provincial IP offices give SMEs patent analysis, technology transfer help, infringement early warning, overseas rights protection support and training.

shares.scope: Published PCT applications, all origins, by applicant type
shares.citation: Patent Cooperation Treaty Yearly Review 2026: Executive Summary, WIPO, 2026
shares.page: Statistics on the international phase - PCT applications: The business sector accounted for the vast majority of PCT filing activity
shares.note: WIPO reports PCT applicants by sector; it does not split the business sector by company size.

shares.scope: Large representative sample of applications filed with the EPO in 2025 by applicants located in European Patent Organisation member states. SMEs follow the European Commission definition (2003/361/EC): independent companies with fewer than 250 staff and turnover below EUR 50 million and/or balance sheet below EUR 43 million. Universities and public research organisations include affiliated technology transfer offices.
shares.citation: EPO Technology Dashboard 2025, European Patent Office, 2026
shares.page: Statistics and indicators > Applicants > Categories (status 2 February 2026)

resources.title: IP for Business
resources.text: WIPO's starting point for businesses on why IP matters and how to manage it.

resources.title: WIPO IP Diagnostics
resources.text: A free online questionnaire that gives a business a report on its IP assets and next steps.

resources.title: IP Management Clinics for SMEs
resources.text: WIPO coaching programme in which IP experts work with selected SMEs on their IP strategy.

resources.title: PCT Newsletter: PCT SME Support Series
resources.text: A question-and-answer series in the PCT Newsletter for small businesses using the PCT, such as No. 3 on using the PCT timeline (June 2026) and No. 4 on deciding where to protect (September 2026).

resources.title: Fee reductions and compensation for smaller applicants
resources.text: The EPO's page on fee support for micro-entities, SMEs, individuals, universities and public research organisations.
